out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Interior of ice machine observed with debris and discoloration.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. MEAT PROJECT (Inspection Date: 08/14/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: rice portion (117F) observed in 1 Dr warmer box.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC stated rice was cooked 2hours prior and will be discarded within 2 hours.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Bags of rice, cans, and containers of seasoning observed stored on the floor of the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for MAYONNAISE were observed reused for the storage of KIMCHI, RICE, AND OTHER FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the WALL TILING at kitchen entry is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Observed changes in plumbing structure in dish washing area, addition to walk in cooler, and outdoor storage area added without approval.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: Walk in cooler. PIC agreed to remove sink and outdoor storage area. If PIC would like to re-install these structures, please contact the health department and building department for guidance.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS will follow up with establishment to ensure Health Policy is in place. MEAT PROJECT (Inspection Date: 02/17/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Temp Reached within 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item(s) was not reheated for hot holding within a sufficient time of 2 hours or less: corn cheese in warmer observed at 48F in the center and 100F on the edges. PIC stated corn is heated by placing cold item directly into slow cooker.
violations.corrective_action: Reheating food for hot holding shall be done rapidly, within 2 hours to prevent growth of pathogens. Corn discarded. EHS discussed to only reheat corn on range plates when ordered.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cooked octopus (48F) and raw pork belly (48F) observed in 2 Dr Raw meats in kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All food items removed from cooler unit. PIC stated items were recently portioned and placed into this unit, items moved to walk in cooler to properly cool.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. DISH MACHINE OBSERVED AT 135F.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. -EHS instructed employee to set up 3 compartment sink.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Food containers observed going through dish machine after EHS already informed staff that dish machine is not properly sanitizing.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Employees took items to 3 compartment sink to wash rinse and sanitize. MEAT PROJECT (Inspection Date: 08/20/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Kimchi, side dishes
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed one (1) live cockroach on the floor of kitchen by dish area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Provide EHS with pest control service at follow up.
